# TagGroup

TagGroup: the wrapper for more than one Tag together. It owns their spacing, wrapping, alignment and disabled state.

Also asked as: tag list.

**Import:** `import { TagGroup } from '@/components';`

**Governed by:** Overflow (`ds guide overflow`)

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/labels/TagGroup/TagGroup.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/labels/TagGroup/TagGroup.stories.jsx` — Wrapping, Collapse, CollapseMenu, CollapseWithSuggestions, MenuKeepsActions, MaxVisible, OneMoreTag, CapNeverSqueezes, WrappedSuggestionsAreNotCounted, NoOverflowWhenItFits, ConditionalChildrenAreNotCounted, OverflowTag, DigitBoundary, StableOnParentRender, SqueezedFirstReplaced, AlignmentRight, Disabled, RemovableSet, CustomOverflowAction, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused, DisabledSet

## Usage

Use `TagGroup` wherever more than one `Tag` appears together: the subjects on a
profile, the filters above a table, the recipients on a message. It is the
right wrapper even when the set is short, because the spacing, wrapping,
alignment and disabled state belong to the set rather than to any tag in it.
`Suggestion` items offered for the field go in the same group; they always sit
at the end of the row, after the tags and `+n`.

## Alternatives

- For one value rather than a set, use `Tag`.
- For a labeled field where the person picks and removes tags, use `TagInput`.
- For a long list that needs paging rather than an overflow count, use `Pagination`.

## Best practices

### Collapse long groups in tight rows. {#collapse-long-groups-in-tight-rows}

`overflow="collapse"` keeps one line and puts the rest behind `+n`, measured by the container's width: give the group a width to fit into, because a group that can grow shows everything. Use `maxVisible` only to show fewer than fit (`maxVisible={0}` puts every tag behind `+n`), and `+n` reserves room for the widest label at its digit count (`+88` when up to `99` tags are hidden).

`Suggestion` children are offers, not values: they are not counted into `+n`, never appear in its menu and always sit after it. Their width comes off the row before tags are counted, so a group with suggestions shows fewer tags, not fewer suggestions. Pass `Suggestion`s as direct children; a custom wrapper must copy the marker (`MySuggestion.isSuggestion = Suggestion.isSuggestion`) or it is counted as a tag. In the `+n` menu, a selectable tag toggles (`aria-pressed`) with the menu staying open, a link tag navigates, a saving tag is a disabled, busy row, a read-only or removable tag is a static row, and remove is only offered on the row, never from the menu.

Do: Collapse in a tight row.
Don't: Wrap pushes the row taller.

### Align to the surrounding text. {#align-to-the-surrounding-text}

`alignment="end"` belongs in a table column whose other cells are right-aligned. Everywhere else, tags read from the start.

Do: Start beside left-aligned text.
Don't: End beside left-aligned text.

### Disable the whole group when read-only. {#disable-the-whole-group-when-read-only}

Pass `isDisabled` on the group so every `Tag` and `Suggestion` inside follows as a unit; never disable one tag and leave its neighbors live.

Do: The whole group disabled.
Don't: A read-only group that looks editable.

### Let the group own the gap. {#let-the-group-own-the-gap}

`Tag` sets `margin: 0` and `TagGroup` sets `gap`, so spacing is defined in one place rather than on both the parent and each child.

## Accessibility

- **Named list.** The group renders `role="list"` named by `label`, wrapping each child in a `listitem` so `Tag` stays usable outside a group. `label` has no default, so a group without it is an unnamed list.
- **Hidden tags leave the list.** Collapsed tags stay out of the tab order and list count until the `+n` menu opens.
- **Suggestions stay reachable.** They are never behind `+n`, so a keyboard user reaches them on the row after `+n`.
- **Disabled is announced per tag.** A selectable tag, a Suggestion and `+n` are native disabled buttons; every other tag is a plain span that carries visually hidden text and reads as "Science, disabled". Nothing in a disabled group takes focus.
- **`+n` announces its count and menu state.** Its name starts with what it shows ("+3 more tags", "+1 more tag"). Enter or Space opens the menu, Tab reaches each interactive item inside, and Escape returns focus to `+n`. Selectable tags toggle in place (`aria-pressed`), links keep their `href`, and remove stays on the row.
- **Suggestions stay on the row.** They are never folded into `+n`, so keyboard users reach them directly.
- **Disabled is announced per item.** Interactive tags and `+n` become native disabled buttons; static tags append visually hidden ", disabled" text.

## Related

- `Tag`: use when configuring individual items inside the group.
- `SmartTag`: use when tagging SMART competency areas inside the group.
- `Suggestion`: use when offering proposed tags at the end of the group.

Same group: `AiMessage` · `ChangeTag` · `CountTag` · `DateTag` · `PromptStarters` · `SmartTag` · `StatusTag` · `Suggestion` · `Tag`

## Parts

1. **Tags and suggestions.** The group owns the gaps between them; a tag carries no margin.
2. **Overflow tag.** A `+n` that opens a menu of the hidden tags, or runs `onOverflowClick`.
3. **List.** A named `list` of `listitem`s; `label` is its accessible name.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | A wrapping row, or a collapsed row with a `+n` tag. |
| Hovered, pressed | None on the group. Each tag reacts as it would alone. |
| Focused | None on the list. Tab reaches the controls inside it in order: selectable tags, links, ×, suggestions, the overflow tag. |
| Disabled | `isDisabled` disables every tag and suggestion and the overflow menu, as a disabled field does. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Gap | `--stack-md` (8) between tags, and between rows. |
| Overflow tag | A selectable Tag, so its ground, ring and disabled tokens are Tag's. |
| Disabled | `--ds-background-disabled` and `--ds-text-disabled`, from `TagContext`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Give the group a `label` that names the set: "Focus areas". | Leave it out, or write "Tags". |
| Order tags by importance or by the order the person added them. | Sort them arbitrarily. |
| Name the overflow by what is hidden: "+3 focus areas". | Say "More" with no count. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `children` | node | — | The tags, and any Suggestions offered beside them. Suggestions always sit at the end, after `+n`, and are never counted or hidden; they must be direct children, or components that carry Suggestion's `isSuggestion` marker. `null` and `false` are skipped rather than counted. |
| `label` | string | — | The group's accessible name — what this set of tags is. |
| `overflow` | enum | `'wrap'` | `wrap` flows onto more lines; `collapse` keeps one line, shows as many tags as fit, and puts the rest behind `+n`. |
| `alignment` | enum | `'start'` | `end` lines the tags and the `+n` up on the end edge, for a right-aligned table column. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | — | Disables every Tag and Suggestion in the group, as a disabled field does. |
| `maxVisible` | number | — | `collapse` only: the most tags to show before `+n`, even when more would fit. By default, as many as fit. |
| `overflowLabel` | func | — | Formats the overflow tag's visible label. Defaults to `+n`; its accessible name starts with that label: "+3 more tags" ("+1 more tag"), or "<label>, 3 more tags" for a custom one. |
| `onOverflowClick` | func | — | Replaces the `+n` menu — for opening a picker or a panel instead. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `id` | string | — | — |
